name: synfeld
description: An open-source SysML v2 learning platform with course, knowledge, AI teaching, and official validation capabilities.

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:teacher-agent
scripts.test: npm run test:public-boundary && npm run test:deployment-contract && npm run test:course-content && npm run test:knowledge-packs && npm run test:validator && npm run test:teacher-public && npm run test:teacher-agent-loop && npm run test:teacher-message-continuity && npm run test:teacher-model-control-plane && npm run test:api
scripts.test:teacher-agent-loop: npm run test:teacher-resource-policy && npm run test:teacher-validator-repair
scripts.test:teacher-model-control-plane: npm run build:teacher-agent && node scripts/test-litellm-config.js && node scripts/test-litellm-reconciler.js && node scripts/test-ai-teacher-model-capability-snapshot.js && node scripts/test-ai-teacher-stage-model-routing.js && node scripts/test-teacher-provider-wire-contract.js
scripts.test:official: npm run setup:official-validator && node scripts/test-official-validator.js && node scripts/test-official-plantuml-interconnection.js
scripts.test:validator: node scripts/test-validator-public.js && node scripts/test-plantuml-interconnection-layout.js && node scripts/test-validator-http-boundary.js && node scripts/test-validator-admission-queue.js
scripts.test:web: node scripts/test-web-i18n.js && node scripts/test-web-phase0.js && node scripts/test-web-phase1.js && node scripts/test-web-phase2.js && node scripts/test-web-phase3.js && node scripts/test-web-phase4.js
